allow: PowerShell(foreach \($f in @\("translators","users","writers"\)\) { $content = Get-Content "C:\\Projects\\migrate\\mongodb collections\\maktabatul-amzad.$f.json" -Raw; $docs = $content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "$f`: $\($docs.Count\) docs" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/books?size=3" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Host "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -First 1 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 } catch { Write-Host "Error: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/categories" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Host "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Host "Count: $\(\($r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json\).Count\)" } catch { Write-Host "Error: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001/api/books?size=3" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Host "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "Books returned: $\($data.Count\)"; if \($data.Count -gt 0\) { Write-Host "First book title: $\($data[0].title[1]\)" } } catch { Write-Host "Error: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001/api/writers" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; $data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "Writers: $\($data.Count\)" } catch { Write-Host "Error: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3001/api/categories" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; $data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "Categories: $\($data.Count\)" } catch { Write-Host "Error: $_" })
